thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread to decide minimal pilot gating for Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quant). Keep it lightweight.

sam - Eng: Proposal: pilot only uses int8 quant and conservative caching heuristics. Feature-flagged per-customer.

li - ML: Gate on two signals: (1) concordance on a canonical prompt set, (2) sampled live A/B mismatch rate. If either crosses threshold, pause.

maria - Solutions: Pilot customers want an "explain" field in the API and a one-click opt-out in console.

eng-obs: We'll provide a dashboard tile: token savings, p95 latency delta, concordance trend, and a rollback button.

devops-bot: deploy 3591234680 started -> canary to optimize-pilot pool

anya - PM: Draft launch criteria:
- concordance drop <= 1.5% vs baseline
- token cost reduction >= 7% median
- error rate no more than +0.1% over 24h
- rollback exercised in staging

sam - Eng: Implementation notes: tag recs with {quant, batch, cache} metadata for joins. Add per-customer feature flags.

li - ML: Add sample-level surprise filter: suppress quant rec if token-level perplexity jumps beyond threshold.

maria - Solutions: I'll recruit 2-3 pilots and draft the FAQ + explainer. Customers: AcmeHealth / ComposeAI candidates.

anya - PM: Owners & dates: maria outreach by Tue, sam runtime tags + canary by Fri, li eval hook by Fri, eng-obs stub by Mon. Reconvene Wed 11am.
